candidate: spark lm_head logits Q8_0 MMQ routing
current_path_summary: Spark2_5 ties lm_head to model.embed_tokens. That module is a GGUF-quantized VocabParallelEmbedding with qweight/qweight_type and no .weight, so LogitsProcessor._compute_lm_head skips the dense/FP branches and calls lm_head.quant_method.apply(), i.e. GGUFLinearMethod.apply -> fused_mul_mat_gguf -> quantized Q8_0 kernels. Logits are never produced by a dequantized BF16 GEMM on this path.

evidence.claim: Single-rank tied config binds lm_head to the embedding module: self.lm_head = self.model.embed_tokens (else ParallelLMHead at 464 with the same quant_config, also GGUF-quantized).

Commit 762e71c comment: '"output" only exists when embeddings are not tied; Spark2_5 ties them.' The spark2_5 name map has no output->lm_head entry, so lm_head is the token_embd Q8_0 matrix, not a separate FP tensor.
VocabParallelEmbedding gets GGUFEmbeddingMethod from GGUFConfig.get_quant_method; create_weights at 342 registers qweight (packed uint8) and qweight_type, not a dense weight.
GGUFLinearMethod.create_weights registers qweight (uint8, is_gguf_weight) and qweight_type only; a GGUF lm_head therefore has no .weight attribute.
should_apply_lm_head_quant_method requires hasattr(lm_head, 'weight') (line 146); a GGUF qweight-only lm_head fails that predicate.

The should_apply branch is skipped; the hasattr(lm_head,'weight') branch at 1158 is skipped; the GGUF else branch at 1203-1213 calls lm_head.quant_method.apply(lm_head, hidden_states, embedding_bias).
GGUFLinearMethod.apply: lm_head qweight has empty shard_id, so it takes the unsharded branch at 590-594 and calls fused_mul_mat_gguf(x, qweight, qweight_type).
fused_mul_mat_gguf: mmvq_safe = 2 for qweight.shape[0] > 5120 (vocab 133120); B<=2 takes ggml_mul_mat_vec_a8 (266-267), B>=3 takes the MMQ branch (269-273).

The research binding is consulted only inside the MMQ branch: if _is_cuda and _research_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4_covered(...): apply(...) else ggml_mul_mat_a8(...). So the W4 apply() is syntactically reachable only through covered().
coverage_reason rejects any batch outside [32, 8192] with rows_outside_32_8192; decode batches B in [1..10] can never select the research W4 target.
coverage_reason also requires 0 < weight.shape[0] <= 131072 and col in (2048, 6656); a 133120-row vocab matrix is rejected with fixed_model_dimensions even at prefill batch >= 32.
Real Spark Q8_0 gate/up qweight geometry (13312, 2176) proves hidden K=2048 (2176 = 2048/32*34), the same packed row width expected for the [133120, 2176] vocab matrix.

decision_rationale: The premise for narrow routing (lm_head runs through a dequantized/FP BF16 GEMM) is false: the quantized GGUF apply() is already the logits path, and for B<=10 it already uses a Q8_0 MMQ/MMVQ kernel. The requested 'batch any' guard is also impossible to make exact because the existing W4 operator admits only batch 32..8192 and vocab rows <= 131072; inserting a direct apply() call at B in [1..10] (or at V=133120) would execute outside the operator's admitted domain and violate the campaign's exact-guard rule. Nothing was modified under python/.
blockers: B1 operator domain: covered() requires batch in [32, 8192] (gguf_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.py:36-37); decode B in [1..10] is outside the admitted domain and its tail behavior is NOT_RUN.
B2 weight geometry: covered() requires weight.shape[0] <= 131072 (helper:38); vocab 133120 exceeds it, so even prefill B>=32 cannot select the W4 target for the lm_head matrix.
B3 already quantized: lm_head logits dispatch to GGUFLinearMethod.apply -> fused_mul_mat_gguf (logits_processor.py:1203-1213, gguf.py:594); there is no dequantized BF16 GEMM to replace at B<=10.
B4 branch-order: B<=2 is claimed by MMVQ before the MMQ branch (gguf.py:266-267), so a decode-side lm_head routing would also need to displace MMVQ, not only the vendor MMQ fallback.

B5 no dead seam: any insertion inside the should_apply_lm_head_quant_method branch is unreachable for GGUF lm_head because it has no .weight (logits_processor.py:146), so the existing routing cannot be expressed there.

B6 native library: the research apply() loads NATIVE-BUILD-MANIFEST.json plus q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.so; the .so is not present in this sandbox and would only ever be exercised for covered shapes, which the lm_head matrix never satisfies.
recheck_trigger: If a Controller model run shows token_embd.weight tensor_type != Q8_0 (i.e. F16/BF16/F32), fused_mul_mat_gguf would take the UNQUANTIZED_TYPES branch x @ qweight.T (gguf.py:263-264) and this finding must be reopened; campaign prior x8 realweights evidence says the vocab matrix is Q8_0, which is what this determination relies on.
